features.quote: In the centre of the tell are six rock-cut caves
features.subtype: rock-cut caves (those of the six not called burial caves)

features.quote: some of which served as burial caves. They have been robbed
features.subtype: rock-cut burial caves (some of the six caves)

date.basis: only a few Byzantine sherds found at the robbed caves; the entry does not date the caves themselves

features.quote: About 20 rock-cut round installations ... including basins and cup marks

notes: The caves are 'in the centre of the tell' (no direction from the site), so position none; s2f3 basins are 'near the burial caves' (no direction). Six caves, some burial: coded as one pit (the non-burial caves) and one grave (the burial caves). Basins of 'varying dimensions' with no size: pool_def unclear. Header 'Cisterns: none' recorded as an explicit absence (C2), as printed, although the entry also reports rock-cut caves. Fig. 34 marks no caves or basins.
